paper_title: SimSMoE Solving Representational Collapse via Similarity Measure
caption: : XMoE Routing Policy
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the performance of two routing policies, XMoE and SimSMoE, as measured by BPC (Bits Per Character) over the course of training, with the x-axis representing training steps in thousands (ranging from 0 to 50 × 10³) and the y-axis showing BPC values from approximately 1.25 to 2.25. Both models exhibit a steep initial decrease in BPC, with XMoE (yellow line with square markers) starting at a BPC of about 2.25 and SimSMoE (magenta line with circular markers) beginning slightly lower at around 1.8. As training progresses, both lines converge and stabilize, with XMoE maintaining a slightly higher BPC than SimSMoE across the entire range, showing a final BPC value of approximately 1.25 for both models by the 50 × 10³ training step mark. The plot demonstrates that both routing policies effectively reduce BPC during training, with SimSMoE achieving a marginally better performance throughout.
